title: Olive and the Wind
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters dr, fl, fr.

pages.brief: Olive the owl sitting at the edge of a calm pond.
Leaves and ripples stirring as a strong wind picks up around the pond.
Olive looking up at the sky turning dark grey with clouds.
Olive the owl flying toward a hollow den in a nearby tree.
Olive the owl resting inside the cosy tree den.
Branches bending and leaves swirling outside the den in the strong wind.
Olive the owl sitting dry and snug inside the den while wind rages outside.
The wind calming, branches outside the den settling still.
Olive the owl flying back down to the calm pond.
